items.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship to automate GitHub PR review, fixes, and policy-based approvals
facts: Claude Ship is available today in beta and can review PRs, fix them, and decide what's ready to merge based on policies each team sets.
It is made up of Code Review, which is already generally available, and two new agents in beta: PR Steward and Claude Approvals.
Eligible Claude Enterprise organizations can claim at least $10,000 in Claude Ship credits to use within 30 days of claiming. Claim by January 15, 2027.

items.title: Google expands Gemini 4 Carbon access to AI Pro users on Antigravity
facts: Resetting Gemini quotas for everyone on Antigravity because we’re upgrading models across tiers!
Paid Pro users will now have access to Carbon and Hydrogen will be available to all users as promised!

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.331 released with Code Mode support on cloud platforms and bug fixes
facts: Added Code Mode support in terminal sessions on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry and Claude Platform on AWS
Fixed MCP tool calls hanging for up to 30 minutes on some malformed replies from a local or WebSocket server
Fixed Code Mode sessions resumed with --resume or --continue in another permission mode losing thinking and the prompt cache

items.title: OpenCode 2.4.0 adds built-in desktop browser, automations, and video generation
facts: Built-In Desktop Browser: Import your sign-ins and browsing history from Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari, and add extensions from Chromium browsers or the Chrome and Edge stores.
Automations: Ask the agent to run a prompt, a script or a shell command on a timer, on a cron schedule or when an MCP server sends an event, and manage them with /automation.
Generate Videos: When a connected provider has a video model, the agent can make videos with generate_video.

items.title: AWS releases Strands Decider v2 models and adds coding agent support to Strands Box
facts: Amazon Web Services Inc. unveiled a new family of open-weight “decision models” called Strands Decider v2, along with the debut of Box CLI, bringing native sandbox support for popular coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Kiro CLI.

The open-weight models are built on Google LLC’s Gemma 4 architecture and they’re available in various sizes, ranging from a lightweight edge version to a beefy 31 billion-parameter variant for complex decision-making.

items.title: Claude Code desktop gets redesigned tabbed side panel for files, changes, and terminal
facts: We've redesigned the side panel in Claude Code on desktop.
Files, Changes, Terminal and your other tools now open as tabs beside your session. You can still move a tab to see several at once, or pop it out into its own window.
Rolling out on Mac. Windows and Linux coming soon!
